intended_object: For a derivation-type Ore extension B[X; δ], the right B-linear map from the free right B-module ⊕_{n∈ℕ} B (modelled as ℕ →₀ Bᵐᵒᵖ) to B[X; δ], sending a finitely supported family (b_n) to Σ Xⁿ · b_n. Inferred from the docstring, the name and the module's use of it to prove that the monomials Xⁿ form a right basis.
explanation: The body is Finsupp.linearCombination Bᵐᵒᵖ applied to the monomials rightPBWMonomial D n = normalForm D (X^n). The lemma rightPBWCombination_term_as_normalForm shows that the Bᵐᵒᵖ-action is right multiplication: b • Xⁿ = Xⁿ · C(b.unop). The lemma rightPBWCombination_finsupp_as_normalForm shows the map sends c to the normal form of Σ Xⁿ · C(c_n). This is exactly the right-coefficient PBW combination map. It is stated for an arbitrary ring B and arbitrary derivation-Ore data, which is the setting where the notion makes sense, and it reuses Mathlib's general linearCombination rather than re-implementing it. Mathlib has no right-coefficient PBW map for this library's Ore-extension type, so there is no counterpart.
